newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Energy Q2 aided by lower pension costs.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Energy Q2 aided by lower pension costs.

text.p: Peoples Energy Corp said Friday lower pension costs helped the company post a slight gain in earnings in the second quarter ended March 31.
Also boosting results were a reduction in operation expenses, additional interest income, and a tax accrual adjustment, the company said.
Offsetting factors included warmer weather, conservation, and the prior period's gain from the expiration of gas storage contracts, the company said.

Despite lower gas deliveries, operating revenues were up nearly 14 percent to $568 million, reflecting the rate effect of a sharp rise in gas prices that occurred nationwide last winter, Peoples Energy said.
Earlier Friday, Peoples Energy reported net income of $63.3 million, or $1.81 a share for the quarter, compared to $62.0 million, or $1.77 a share, a year ago.
Peoples Energy shares were up 1/2 at 34 Friday.
